name: Lighteval matching and likelihood metrics
description: A bounded source-only profile of native emitted matching and likelihood metrics in the batch evaluator. String matching is a score policy, not evidence that an original payload satisfied a case-sensitive schema. No measured result, selected dataset or deployment gate is supplied. See research/T6-deployment-operations/evaluation.md.
